screen main "Add" plus
  stat count(dig month), "this month"
  stat since(dig), "days since the last entry"
  form dig
screen charts "Charts" chart
  daybars last 7 days, count(dig on it)
  list dig
remind "Time to add garden" at 12:00, 18:00
